profile.headline: Software Engineer at SpaceX
profile.summary: I focus on solving problems in graph theory, mechanism design, and data-driven decision-making. I use machine learning and statistical analysis to optimize networks, forecast demand, and model interactions. I’ve built models for computer vision, game theory, and deep learning. Outside of work, I enjoy painting, creative writing, reading, and volleyball!
